_about: SINGLE-TRANSLATION SHELF: more one-off English translations of continental and world fiction: Pushkin's prose tales (Keane) and Queen of Spades (Sutherland Edwards), Gogol's Cossack Tales and Home Life in Russia, Andreyev ×4 (The Red Laugh, The Dark, The Little Angel, When the King Loses His Head), Gorky's Three Men, Kuprin, Chekhov's Black Monk (Long), Tolstoy's Sebastopol (Millet), Fernán Caballero's La Gaviota, Madame de Staël's Corinne (Isabel Hill), Le Sage's Asmodeus, Cervantes's Persiles and Galatea, Lope de Vega's Pilgrim of Castile (1621), Bécquer's Romantic Legends, Alarcón, Pardo Bazán, Verga's House by the Medlar-Tree, Serao ×2, D'Annunzio, Hugo's Last Day of a Condemned (Campbell), Balzac's Love in a Mask, George Sand, Zola ×2, Mirbeau, Loti, Bourget ×2, Anatole France ×2, Apollinaire's The Poet Assassinated (Josephson, 1923), Gide's Prometheus Illbound (1919), Maurois's Ariel (Ella D'Arcy, 1924), Le Corbeau's The Forest Giant (T. E. Lawrence, 1924), Xavier de Maistre's Journey Round My Room, Carové's Story Without an End (Sarah Austin), Suttner's Lay Down Your Arms, Sienkiewicz, Undset's Jenny (1921), Lie, Topelius, Siwertz, Rosegger, Ségur, Erckmann-Chatrian, Eugène Sue, Aubert de Gaspé's Cameron of Lochiel (Roberts), Perelaer's Baboe Dalima, Murai's Kibun Daizin and Maupassant (Boyd). Each title gates on its own translator (_surname_by_slug). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 43); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
